$comment: PAL multipliers applied to BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor) to get TDEE. Consistent with knowledge/nutrition_rules.json: tdee = BMR * activity_factor.

items.label: Sedentary
items.description: Desk job, little or no deliberate exercise.

items.label: Lightly active
items.description: Light exercise or sport 1-3 days a week.

items.label: Moderately active
items.description: Moderate exercise or sport 3-5 days a week.

items.label: Extra active
items.description: Physical job plus hard daily training, or twice-daily sessions.
